XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure to start engine and engage gears
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: BRAKES | P057C | SWITCH | PEDAL | BRAKE | ON | ON | IGNITION | MIL | START | STOP | YELLOW | YELLOW |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage technician; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Brakes

  • Device: Brake pedal switch

  • Fault: Engine fault light and Start&Stop fault light illuminated. The vehicle continues to operate normally

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P057C (Brake pedal position sensor – Low signal)

  • Cause: Faulty brake pedal switch

• Action: Check that the brake pedal switch is working correctly and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The faulty component showed no visible defects and, following its replacement, no adjustments were required using diagnostic equipment, thereby permanently resolving the fault.
    The switch is located above the brake pedal.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 0.7 h.
